jobs.title: Asset Manager
jobs.description: The Beverage RTM Asset Manager leads the strategy and governance of Monde Nissin’s beverage chiller and cold-asset portfolio across channels, customers, and territories. The role ensures that assets are strategically deployed, commercially productive, properly maintained, and managed throughout their lifecycle in support of beverage growth and route-to-market priorities. Key Responsibilities Lead the strategy, planning, budgeting, and productivity management of beverage chillers, coolers, and other cold assets. Manage the end-to-end asset deployment process, including outlet qualification, approvals, installation, tagging, handover, and post-deployment review. Optimize asset placement, capacity, assortment, visibility, and utilization to improve cold availability and beverage conversion. Govern asset maintenance and lifecycle management, including repairs, preventive maintenance, refurbishment, replacement, redeployment, recovery, and retirement. Drive cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Trade Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance, Procurement, distributors, customers, and service providers to ensure strong execution and governance.

jobs.title: Customer Service Officer
jobs.description: Kitchen Warehouse is Australia's leading kitchenware retailer, and our Manila office is the offshore hub supporting our Australian stores and online business. As a Customer Service Representative, you are the first point of contact for our customers, helping them across email, live chat and calls. You will resolve enquiries, process returns, and coordinate with suppliers, stores and our despatch team to deliver a smooth, accurate and genuinely helpful experience for every customer. What you will do Assist customers with enquiries submitted through email, live chat and calls. Process customer returns accurately and on time. Communicate with suppliers regarding product queries and warranty claims. Communicate with stores regarding customer orders and enquiries. Review orders and advise customers of progress or action taken. Communicate with Warehouse Despatch in regard to customer orders. Liaise with and assist the Customer Service Support Officer. Liaise with Australia Post regarding delayed or missing parcels. Identify customer complaints and escalate to the Customer Service Team or Customer Service Manager as required. Follow procedures, guidelines and policies accurately to complete assigned tasks. Perform data entry across a number of platforms. Work hours and days based on the requirements of the business (for example, Sunday to Thursday between 6am and 8pm). Assist with other additional tasks as required.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description: We are assisting our client, an early-stage consumer brand, in hiring a Growth Marketing Manager to lead growth across e-commerce, paid media and digital marketing. This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable analyzing performance data, identifying growth opportunities and turning business priorities into campaigns that drive measurable results. Working closely with the Founder, the Growth Marketing Manager will help shape and execute the client’s growth strategy across DTC, paid media, social, creator campaigns and key retail initiatives. The role will also lead and coordinate the Content Marketing Manager and Visual & Multimedia Designer, ensuring that strategy, content, creative and performance marketing work together toward clear commercial objectives. The ideal candidate is proactive, commercially minded and comfortable building processes and testing new approaches as the business grows. Proven experience in growth marketing, performance marketing, digital marketing or e-commerce, preferably within consumer, lifestyle, wellness, sports, food & beverage or direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands. Hands-on experience managing Meta Ads campaigns and advertising budgets. Strong working knowledge of Shopify or similar e-commerce platforms, GA4, Meta Ads Manager and other analytics tools. Ability to analyze data and understand how creative, paid media and conversion rates contribute to revenue, while considering brand identity and customer needs. Commercial awareness, with the ability to turn insights into actionable recommendations aligned with business priorities. Strong project management skills, with experience managing multiple campaigns and coordinating or leading creative, content or social media teams. A proactive, resourceful and accountable approach, with the flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and help build processes in an early-stage
